description: This file defines the main chat interface component for a React-based chat application, including message rendering, user input handling, prompt suggestions, theme controls, and session management.

classes.name: SessionConfigModel
classes.description: Component for editing chat session configuration including memory prompts and mask settings.

classes.name: PromptToast
classes.description: Component to show prompt hints or session configuration modal.

classes.name: useSubmitHandler
classes.description: Hook to handle submit key logic and composition events.

classes.name: PromptHints
classes.description: Component displaying prompt suggestions with keyboard navigation.

classes.name: ClearContextDivider
classes.description: UI component to clear chat context.

classes.name: ChatAction
classes.description: Reusable button component with icon and label for chat actions.

classes.name: useScrollToBottom
classes.description: Hook managing auto-scroll behavior for chat window.

classes.name: _Chat
classes.description: Main chat interface component handling message rendering, user input, and interactions.

methods.name: scrollDomToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls chat container to the bottom.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Handles user input submission and triggers chat messages.

methods.name: onUserStop
methods.description: Stops ongoing message streaming for a given message ID.

methods.name: onResend
methods.description: Resends a user or assistant message.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a message from the session.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Handles image upload via file input or clipboard paste.
